billing_caveat: Runtime/resource limits and conservative reservations are enforced. Provider/control-plane failure can delay cleanup; this is not an AWS billing invoice or provider-enforced account spending cap.
evidence_ceiling_note: Separate bounds: source archive expanded <=512 MiB; runtime evidence expanded <=2 GiB; all three compressed S3 result objects together <=1 GiB. Oversize output is an explicit failed/partial run, never silent successful omission. Failure packets preserve all candidate checkpoints and sealed predictions when they fit the declared transfer ceiling.
